# OpenRocket source reference

This repository intentionally does not include the real OpenRocket source or generated build outputs.

The upstream source project is located here:

- https://github.com/openrocket/openrocket

The recommended workflow for the real validation phase is:

1. Clone the upstream repository to a local working directory.
2. Record the selected commit hash or release tag.
3. Confirm the Java toolchain version required by that revision.
4. Run the Gradle tasks to identify the generated JAR artifacts.
5. Inspect the manifest, classpath entries, and candidate main class.
6. Stage the generated JARs and resources into a browser-accessible directory.
7. Launch the app under CheerpJ and measure startup, runtime, memory, and compatibility.

This file is only a source reference note to keep the investigation process traceable.
